_meta.description: Full VehicleState snapshot (GET /api/vehicles/{vehicleId}/snapshot) for a car that is IN SERVICE with a known estimated completion (MYR-316, contracts 0.17.0). serviceEstimatedEndAt is meaningful only alongside status 'in_service' — the server clears it automatically on any other status, which is why the sibling parked fixture (snapshot.json) omits it entirely. Authored here from the contracts 0.17.0 field docs; replace with the upstream file the moment one exists.
